candidate.user_submission: Di pikin no dey convulse now, e never get convulsion before, e no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. E fit drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything. Di pikin na 2 months old. E dey cough or e dey get wahala to breathe. E no get diarrhoea. E no get ear problem. E no get fever. I count di breath for one full minute. No chest dey go inside. Di pikin calm when I dey check am. Di cough don dey for 3 days. Pulse oximeter no dey. E no dey wheeze again and again. E dey breathe 50 times for one minute. No stridor when e calm. E no dey wheeze.
